items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) and S Jalen Pitre will not travel to London and are ruled OUT vs Jaguars. Tank Dell also OUT.
items.implication: Full backfield to Woody Marks or committee; Marks saw 98% snaps last week post-Montgomery exit
items.opportunity: Woody Marks RB2 upside while out

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled OUT for Week 6 vs Panthers due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; out indefinitely pending treatment (likely blood thinners). Tanner McKee to start.
items.why: Ultrasound revealed movement in clot after initial clearance to play in London
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles offense and implied total tank; Saquon/Smith already limited heighten risk
items.opportunity: Tanner McKee volume; Panthers DST upside

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder) DNP second straight day.
items.implication: Likely limited/OUT; Bills WR depth benefits

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) DNP for second straight day.
items.implication: Monitor for OUT/GTD; depth chart shift if sits

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice Thursday (second straight); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited. 24 Eagles on injury report.
items.implication: Likely OUT or limited; handcuff/Dameon Pierce/Steele upside if out; Smith limited better than full DNP
items.opportunity: Pierce/Steele if Barkley OUT; reverse if unexpectedly IN

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice (hamstring) DNP again Thursday post-bye.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy target share if OUT

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially DNP again Thursday; day-to-day with realistic chance to play vs Browns but Huntley likely if not.
items.implication: If out, Flowers ceiling drops; Huntley starts
items.opportunity: Monitor Friday; Flowers still elite but lower ceiling without Lamar

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams (hamstring) full participant second straight day; on track to start vs Falcons pending clearance.
Loves Mike Evans as WR4 vs Commanders; season-high 36% target share last week, 45%+ routes when Deebo off (Deebo multi-week out). Washington secondary buffet.
items.why: Target share spike + Deebo absence + matchup
items.opportunity: High target volume vs soft secondary

items.text: Loves Rhamondre Stevenson as RB9 vs Jets; Henderson multi-week high-ankle out. When Henderson inactive W1, Stevenson 85% snaps/23 touches; 16.3 PPG on 15+ touches since 2024.
items.why: Henderson multi-week OUT confirmed; prior volume data

items.text: Since Breece Hall injury, Jets RB snaps: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Nwangwu 0 in two full games. Hall remains week-to-week, no practice.
items.implication: Allen clear lead back and must-start while Hall out

items.text: Saquon Barkley turns 30 in February. Eagles gold standard at moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz). Contenders with RB need should call.
Hates Jaylen Waddle as WR28 vs SEA; 204 yards season, 67% in one game, avg 16.5 in other 4. Ugly matchup + production concerns. (Later Q shoulder then returned TNF).

Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane (rookie) expected back to practice 4 weeks post-wrist surgery; shot to play this weekend. Offseason buzz as Bateman ice; returns to elite 6.4 YPP offense even without full Lamar.
